title: Optimising images, fonts and critical resources

videos.script:
Most of what a page downloads is not its code. It is pictures and type. {{path}} And some of what it downloads holds everything else up: nothing is painted until the stylesheet is there, and text is not shown until its font is.

{{cover}} You will give the planner a cover picture, as a designer would hand one over: eight megabytes of PNG. Lighthouse puts the page's LCP at almost forty seconds. {{formats}} Then the same picture in three widths and three formats, and markup that lets the browser choose. {{chosen}} You will watch a phone and a laptop pick different files from the same tag.

{{fonts}} Then a web font. Hidden text while it loads, or text that changes under the reader: two choices, measured, and a fallback adjusted to take the same room. {{inline}} And last, the stylesheet itself, moved into the page, so the first paint waits for nothing.
